label: S1 reached at D2, late in the episode (trials 90-99)
explanation: Fires only at D2 and only when the reached state is S1 (100% of activations on state==S1 input; never on D1/GO, never on S2). Within S1 D2 steps it is strongly gated by episode time: 78% of activation mass falls on episode trials 90-99 and 99% on trials 50-99, with near-zero firing in trials 10-59. Equivalently it tracks low model value (79% of mass where value < 5.22, the lowest bin), which is itself a correlate of the episode end. Stronger when the S1 arrival was via a common a1 transition (a1->S1 holds 94% of mass; a2->S1 rare arrivals fire weakly). D2&S1&ep_trial>=90 gives dev F1 0.58 (P 0.49, R 0.72, mass 0.78); adding action==1 raises precision to 0.59 but cuts recall, and a value threshold performs about the same. Uses only observed variables (state is shown at D2; episode time is internally trackable). Remaining misses are weak activations at S1 D2 in trials 60-89; false positives are mainly S1 D2 steps late in the episode reached by a rare a2 transition.
